scope: Read-only camera-space geometry review; manufacturing files unchanged
coordinate_system: R4 STEP coordinates, millimetres; Z=0 is main front; decreasing Z points outward
feature: Original upper-front rectangular notch, preserved as camera-module space
assignment_limit: STEP has no named camera component, lens or entrance-pupil model. This is a measured original-case notch, not an invented lens location or optical field of view.
important_limits: Whole outer-case corners are not claimed unobstructed: four intentional corner stops retain the official shell. The tested central106x97.6mm rectangle and original notch remain clear.
The nearby top lip is1.45mm above the notch's upper edge in XY and ahead of the original front plane. Normal clearance does not prove freedom from off-axis vignetting.
Actual lens centre/depth, protrusion, module/flex envelope, field of view, focus and full-frame selfie image are not verified by these STEP files.
No photo-save or selfie-capture software feature is asserted. Existing live camera operation is separate evidence supplied by the project owner.
physical_acceptance: Dry-fit the owned board/LCD/camera in the unchanged official case and TEST06 with retainer and actual cables before the240mm print.
Keep the entire original upper-front notch open: no leather, adhesive, film, trim, gasket or cable over it; do not load the lens or pinch the camera flex.
Compare the live preview before and after dry assembly with a plain grid/card at the intended selfie distance; check centre and all four frame corners for casing, dark corners and focus changes.
Repeat with final leather, retainer and covers installed. If obstruction/vignetting occurs, stop and revise that local lip/camera relief before approving the full print.
result: No added R4 geometry blocks the measured notch, its1mm forward allowance, or the tested central functional front rectangle. Physical lens/FOV alignment remains a gate.
